idea:
Implement durable persistence for the session store so that backend sessions (e.g., Claude Code `--resume` with session IDs) can survive process restarts, crashes, and separate `ralph run` invocations.

## Requirements

- Session store must be saved to disk during workflow execution
- Session store must be restored during project state reconstruction
- Session invalidation rules (`session_reuse_reset_on_rollback`, `session_reuse_reset_on_prompt_change`) must continue to work correctly
- Solution must handle concurrent access and partial writes gracefully

## Proposed Implementation

Persist session store to a file (`session_store.json`) in the loop artifacts directory:
- Write `session_store.json` after each workflow step that populates/modifies the session store
- Load `session_store.json` during `reconstruct_project_state_internal` if it exists
- Clear/invalidate the file when rollback or prompt change triggers session reset

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Session records persist to disk in a structured format (JSON)
- [ ] `reconstruct_project_state` loads existing session store from disk if available
- [ ] Session reuse works across separate `ralph run` invocations
- [ ] Rollback correctly invalidates persisted sessions when `session_reuse_reset_on_rollback` is enabled
- [ ] Prompt changes correctly invalidate persisted sessions when `session_reuse_reset_on_prompt_change` is enabled
- [ ] No session leakage between different projects or loops
- [ ] Tests verify cross-restart session persistence and invalidation rules

## Relevant Code Locations

- `src/project/lifecycle.rs:216-230` — state reconstruction (add session store loading)
- `src/project/state.rs:48-53` — `SessionStore` struct (may need serialization traits)
- `src/workflow/orchestrator.rs:2320-2332` — session store population (add persistence after updates)
- `src/cli/rollback.rs:139-154` — session invalidation (add file deletion/clearing)
